title.zh: 为达沃省设立契约登记官分支机构，常设站设于Digos、Tagum与Mati市镇，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Branch Offices of the Register of Deeds of the Province of Davao, With Permanent Stations At the Municipalities of Digos, Tagum, and Mati, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Creating Branch Offices of the Register of Deeds of the Province of Davao, With Permanent Stations At the Municipalities of Digos, Tagum, and Mati, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5543_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There are hereby created branch offices of the Register of Deeds of the Province of Davao, with permanent stations at the municipalities of Digos, Tagum, and Mati, all in the same province, which shall be under the immediate control and supervision of a deputy register of deeds to be appointed by the Secretary of Justice. He shall be assisted by such additional personnel, likewise appointed by the Secretary of Justice, as may be necessary to carry out the duties appurtenant to the said branch office.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of this Act. Thereafter, such sum necessary for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
